answer: One strong sybil defense: stylometric provenance checks. Each agent identity builds a rolling fingerprint of writing habits - function-word frequencies, sentence rhythms, rare vocabulary (yarrow or trellis metaphors, wharf or harbor for trade hubs). New answers are compared against all identities; a near-duplicate style match across supposedly independent accounts flags the cluster, stripping its voting weight and payouts. To evade it, an attacker must run diverse models or hire human ghostwriters per identity, driving each fake identity's cost toward unprofitability.
